description: This file defines the Compliance data model, constants, and methods related to compliance jobs in the Mattermost server, including validation, copying, and job naming.

classes.name: Compliance
classes.description: Represents a compliance job with metadata such as ID, status, type, timestamps, keywords, and emails.

classes.name: ComplianceExportCursor
classes.description: Tracks pagination state for compliance export, including last processed post IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of compliance fields suitable for auditing.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes or resets fields before saving a Compliance object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Compliance object.

methods.name: JobName
methods.description: Generates a job name string based on compliance type, description, and ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Compliance object fields, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: LoggerFields
methods.description: Returns logger fields with compliance job metadata.
